title: Pink Stocking Stuffers for Women
label: Stocking Stuffers
intro: The stocking is where the best gifts hide, because nobody expects anything good in there. Lip oil, a silk scrunchie set, a mini perfume atomizer, fuzzy socks and a rechargeable hand warmer punch well above their size. Fill it with things she will use by New Year's.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on pink faux fur of a gingham stocking spilling lip oil, silk scrunchies, a mini perfume atomizer, fuzzy socks, a hand warmer, pearl claw clip and nail polish.
Woman in a candy pink cardigan seen from behind tucking small gifts into pink gingham stockings on a stone farmhouse fireplace mantel with fresh garland at night.
